provenance.dataset: IDSSE / Sportec Open DFL dataset (2022/23 Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga)
provenance.attribution: Deutsche Fussball Liga (DFL); Bassek et al., Scientific Data (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y
provenance.scope: events: 7 matches; tracking: 1 match(es) (J03WPY); spatial: 7 matches

bands.source: realism v2 analysis 2026-10-13 (physical-report.md, dominance-report.md): IDSSE, 7 matches, full-match outfielders; aggregates only

passing.source: realism v2 analysis 2026-10-13 (carrier-report.md C3/C5/C6/C9/C10, gk-report.md, finalthird.json A2/A3) and P2 task-8b-report.md (ball thirds): IDSSE, 7 matches; aggregates only. Bands are plan 8c rulings.

first_tick_share.label: Open-play passes dying at the boot (first tick, under 1 m)

near1_completion.label: Completion, opponent within 1 m at release

avail_10_20_completion.label: Completion to an available receiver, 10–20 m

avail_30p_completion.label: Completion to an available receiver, 30 m+

crosses_per_match.label: Open-play crosses per match (10 s after restarts excluded)

cross_contact_m.label: Cross end point from the goal line, median (m)

release_median_lt2_s.label: Time to release, received under 2 m pressure, median (s)

release_under1_lt2.label: Released within 1 s, received under 2 m pressure

ball_own_third.label: Ball in the possessing team's own third

duels.source: realism v2 analysis 2026-10-13 (tackles-report.md, transitions-report.md, finalthird-report.md B2, carrier-report.md C1); spec P4 for defender, attacker and aerial fouls; IDSSE, 7 matches; aggregates only. Support rows: tackles.json real.defender_win_by_n3 (defenders within 3 m of the carrier, tackler included): none = 0.36 (n 326, info); exactly 1 = 0.51 (n 599); 2 or more = 0.60 (n 142 x 0.61 + 16 x 0.50). Bands are plan 8d rulings.

tackle_win_behind.label: Tackle attempts won, approach from the side or behind (60° or more)

defender_fouls_per_match.label: Defender fouls per match (tackle and take-on)

fk_30m_per_match.label: Free kicks within 30 m of goal per match

yellows_per_match.label: Yellow cards per match (incl. second yellows)

join_0_5.label: Counter-press: loser reaches 3 m of the ball within 3 s, 0–5 m away at the loss

setpieces.source: realism v2 analysis 2026-10-13 (setpieces-report.md, offball-report.md T4/T5, gk-report.md G3, spec P5); IDSSE, 7 matches; aggregates only. Bands are plan 8e rulings. dead_speed_mps pools both sides; the analysis reported each side separately (attackers 0.8-1.5, defenders 0.7-1.6 m/s by restart type), so 1.2 is a pooled reading.
